title: Verify, review, and deliver the real workspace

comments.text: Local evidence so far: targeted Python messaging/auth/coverage tests passed 100 tests; migration helper tests passed 2 tests; targeted formatting/lint passed; the web typecheck, 45 tests, and production static build passed before final sheet integration. Full final gates, responsive visual QA, sub-agent review, PR/CI, merge, and live development verification remain. Deployment is blocked by chatticus-be9e3e; no legacy migration has been applied.
